test_group_by: test the group_by method to group a DataFrame by column and aggregate values with sum
test_group_by_mean_by_dtype: test group_by mean computation across all numeric and temporal Polars data types
test_group_by_quantile_datetime: test group_by quantile computation on datetime columns with different time units and timezones
test_group_by_iteration: test iterating over group_by groups to access group keys and their corresponding row data
test_group_by_having: test group_by having clause to filter groups based on aggregate conditions like mean threshold
